verbatimOpening: FIX-FIRST. O código em 5c84ce4d0feafaa63211aa4169be65b6f492e1b6 não satisfaz integralmente G1 nem encerra o FIX-FIRST r4. Dois casos já apontados continuam alcançáveis: bound held ausente ainda vira zero, e a retomada pela chave original ainda retorna HOLD antes de procurar a completion vencedora. O novo parser também deixa de liquidar o usage final de Chat presente na própria fixture positiva e permite que um evento posterior ao terminal Responses substitua a medição econômica. As obrigações de §3 permanecem abertas.

repairs.CE-R4-01: CONFERE para o caso literal; introduz CE-R5-01.
repairs.CE-R4-02: CONFERE para o caso literal; conjunto de terminais incompleto: CE-R5-03.
repairs.CE-R4-03: CONFERE para o caso literal; substituição por fechamento posterior: CE-R5-02.
repairs.CE-R4-04: NÃO CONFERE integralmente — negativo presente é HOLD; ausente ainda soma zero. CE-R5-04.
repairs.CE-R4-05: NÃO CONFERE — a busca ficou depois do retorno pela chave existente. CE-R5-05.

counterexamples.CE-R5-01: SUCCESS() has finish_reason stop with usage null, then a chunk with empty choices and usage 3/2. readClose discards the second chunk, so the consumer gets 3/2 and the ledger stays terminal-held. Chat finish and the final usage chunk are distinct phases; do not promote an earlier intermediate counter.
counterexamples.CE-R5-02: Two response.completed events in one body. The consumer stops at the first; the parser keeps the last and can also clear invalid. Respect the canonical terminal boundary.
counterexamples.CE-R5-03: HTTP 200 response.failed is a protocol terminal and must release only the slot. The economic bound stays when usage is unknown.
counterexamples.CE-R5-04: A held row whose bound omits a dimension the envelope requires is summed as zero and admits another reservation. Validate recovered records against the envelope's required dimensions before occupancy. Negative-present repair stands.
counterexamples.CE-R5-05: Original key k was forwarded without completion; retry k#2 has the durable completion. Reopen of k holds at the existing row before the winning-completion search. Conflict refusal stays before any reuse.
counterexamples.CE-R5-06: EA-20 still passes if usage 12 is clamped to 10 while the breach flag is set. The oracle must read the persisted 12.
